fields.aka: Ghanaśyāma Cakravartī, Ghanaśyāma dāsa, Narahari dāsa, Narahari Dāsa Ghanaśyāma Dāsa, Rasuiyā Pūjārī
fields.place: Born at Renapura (Rayanpur, by Jangipur), Murshidabad; Vṛndāvana (the cook of Śrī Govindajī)
fields.works: Bhaktiratnākara, Narottama-vilāsa, Śrīnivāsa Caritra, Gītā-candrodaya, Chandah-samudra, Gaura-carita-cintāmaṇi, Namamrta-samdura, Paddhati-pradipa, Saṅgīta-sāra-saṅgraha
fields.notes:
Parents were Jagannātha (disciple of Viśvanātha Cakravartī) and an ardent devotee; born at Renapura, Murshidabad. He remained unmarried until parents died, then went to Vṛndāvana where he served Govindaji for three-quarters his life.

He had two names: Ghanaśyāma (his other name, also his signature in his songs) and Narahari — «Narahari dāsa Ghanaśyāma dāsa»; Ghanaśyāma Cakravartī #328 was the same person (merged 06-11-2026, Whisper). As Govindajī's cook he was called «Rasuiyā Pūjārī»; an accomplished musician as well as an author.
